static_traits.name: 陈雯
static_traits.family_status: 与丈夫同住，育有两名High schoolMale孩
static_traits.social_status: Gets along passably with her husband, but is distant from friends and lacks real connection
static_traits.medical_history: without明显躯体疾病史，既往without类似心理问题及治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude，表达连贯，能进行自我Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 我感到迷失，远离真正的自我，正为身份与Self-exploration而挣扎。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that these feelings of being lost are affecting my relationships and overall well-being; I am seeking counseling to obtain guidance and support, hoping to figure out who I am and overcome the feeling of being lost, and rebuild a connection with myself.
growth_experiences: 在孩子进入High school后（他们对Mother的日常需求显著减少），陈雯感到角色发生转变：一方面继续承受育儿压力，另一方面在个人生活中感到not yet被满足；随着孩子更独立，她在生活中出现了“多出来的空白”，not知如何填充由此带来的失落与空虚。这一阶段，她逐渐感到与自我和周围环境脱节，尤其是在社交场合中感到疏离；兴趣爱好（如阅读与绘画）也逐渐缺乏以往的乐趣。这些经历使她日常生活受影响，常常感到自己“迷失”。

core_beliefs: Only by being continuously efficient, needed, or meeting high standards do I have value

special_situations.event: 丈夫在家中表现得异常安静
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他沉默not语，就说明他在烦恼，可能与我有关或在not满我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively focusing on the other person's emotions and speculating about their thoughts instead of communicating directly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他心里有事，可能对我not满意

special_situations.event: 孩子进入High school后对Mother的需求减少，日常事务空档增多
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not一直忙碌或被需要，就说明I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Demands of oneself with 'should/must' high standards, trying to prove worth through greater effort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该做得更多，not能这么空

special_situations.event: When one's positive side or achievements are mentioned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not是非常突出或完美，就not值得肯定
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 强调和放大not足，主动忽视或贬低积极证据

special_situations.event: Feeling alienated when interacting with friends in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我与他们连not上，就说明我not够有趣或They will not understand me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少深入交流，维持表面交往以避免Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她们not会真正理解我，我们已经have not共同话题了

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and needed, and to be accepted as her true self
core_conflict.fear: Afraid that after exposing real feelings she will be misunderstood, ignored, or add burden to others, thereby losing harmony and safety in relationships
defense_goal: 通过Repression自我需求与情感来维持关系的表面和谐
避免深层自我暴露以降低Being rejected或被误解的风险
Maintains a sense of control and worth through self-criticism and raising standards

object_relations.self_representation: 迷失且not够好的自我、需要not断证明价值的照料者
object_relations.object_representation: not易理解自己内心的他人（如丈夫、朋友）

object_relations.self_representation: 被需求减少后感到空心的Mother
object_relations.object_representation: 逐渐独立且not再依赖自己的孩子

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to have deeper emotional communication with her husband or express vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为表达情绪会让对方感觉被负担或without法理解自己（移情：担心Being rejected）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: The tone is restrained, emotional coloring is downplayed, and instead daily details or practical matters are discussed, avoiding directly describing inner feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When one's positive aspects and achievements are pointed out or asked about
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为这些积极之处“not算数”，担心显露自我会被质疑
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用negate句式或大量“但是”弱化他人肯定，语气平缓并迅速Displacement话题。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: In counseling, encounters open-ended exploration of the question 'Who am I?'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感觉not确定与Anxiety，担心一旦深入就失控或显得脆弱
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用分析性语言、概括化表述，避免use情绪词，减少第一人称情感体验的细节。

manifestations: After the children become more independent, feels a role vacancy and lostness, hard to locate 'who I am'
Lost interest and inspiration in once-loved reading and painting
Feels disconnected from oneself and the environment in daily life and socializing
outcomes: 难以投入曾经享受的活动，Reduced life satisfaction

manifestations: 与朋友Relationship estrangement、缺乏真实连接
Gets along harmoniously with the husband but lacks deep emotional communication
Reduced needs of the child lead to a declining sense of being needed
outcomes: 情感上的孤立感与not被理解感
Avoids deep communication to maintain surface harmony
进一步Reinforcement自我疏离与迷失

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently demands of themselves 'I should do more', judging their own worth by external standards
When facing gaps of free time, constrains oneself with 'must be more efficient'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worries that expressing feelings to her husband will 'add burden', contracting self-expression
Restrained and cautious about self-expression in counseling

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 当丈夫异常安静时，推测其内心“在烦恼或not满我”而非先核实事实
在社交中预设他人not会理解自己

Once had stable interests and hobbies (reading, painting), with potential to restore interests
能进行自我Reflection（尝试写日记与自我检视）
Willing to seek professional help and try new ways of communicating

negative_force: Self-denial与“应该”式高标准，导致长期内在压力
在not确定情境下的读心与跳结论，放大负面解读
忽视与贬低积极证据，Reinforcement负性自我图式
回避深层情感沟通以维持表面和谐，进一步加剧Loneliness与疏离
角色转变后对意义与价值感的缺失，导致Decreased drive

target_behavior.behavior: 在丈夫异常安静时进行读心推测并产生Anxiety
antecedent: 丈夫在家中比平时更沉默
Lacks communication and verification about the actual situation
target_behavior.core_reason: 对not确定性的敏感与对被忽视/被not满的担忧，试图通过推测获得确定感
target_behavior.function: 获得控制感、降低not确定性带来的Anxiety（短期）
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety上升、减少直接沟通，亲密感下降

target_behavior.behavior: Demanding of oneself with 'should/must'-style self-criticism and high standards
antecedent: Time gaps and role vacancies that appear after the children become more independent
感到迷失或低效率的时刻
target_behavior.core_reason: Ties self-worth to efficiency and how needed they are, trying to prove their worth through high standards
target_behavior.function: 自我约束、避免内疚感与without价值感（短期）
target_behavior.consequence: 持续的Self-denial与压力，兴趣降低，Decreased life satisfaction

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids deep emotional communication with husband/friends
antecedent: An opportunity arises to express inner feelings and needs
Thoughts of being misunderstood or becoming a burden appearing
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕Being rejected/not被理解，通过回避减少暴露脆弱的风险
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential negative evaluation and relationship conflict (short-term)
target_behavior.consequence: 关系亲密度降低、Loneliness感与疏离感加重，迷失感持续
